hero.title: Procurement
hero.lead: Transparent procedures for selecting suppliers of goods, works, and services for ECRT.

goal.title: Purpose and principles
goal.body: The main goal of procurement at ECRT is the efficient and timely provision of goods, works, and services required by the company.
items: Equal access for participants and documented procedure stages.
Economic justification of supplier and contractor selection.

legal.title: Legal framework
legal.body: Procurement is carried out in accordance with Federal Law No. 223-FZ of 18 July 2011, related regulations, and ECRT internal policies.

eis.title: Unified procurement information system
eis.body: The official public procurement portal under Russian law.

rts.title: RTS-tender platform
rts.body: Electronic trading platform used for ECRT procurement procedures.
